title: 经济学家：1.1万亿贸易顺差，回流路径为何彻底变了？
speaker: Unknown

segments.en: And I guess my follow-up there would be how that is showing up currently in the economy is in the form of, to your point, you know, a big part of the exports is AI.
segments.zh: 我的追问是，这在当前经济中如何体现？正如你所说，出口的很大一部分是AI。

segments.en: The last export boom in the 2000s, that massive trade, you know, all those reserves, we saw it recycled into U.S. Treasuries.
segments.zh: 2000年代的上一次出口繁荣，大规模贸易，那些储备，我们看到它们回流到了美国国债。

segments.en: What is China doing with this export windfall? Where is that money going? Where is it being recycled to?
segments.zh: 中国如何处理这笔出口收益？这些钱去了哪里？回流到了何处？

segments.en: I think we posted 1.3 trillion. If I'm not mistaken, last year in terms of the trade surplus. That's also a key question I have, really. What happens with the exchange rate?
segments.zh: 我记得去年贸易顺差是1.3万亿美元。如果我没记错的话。这也是我的一个关键问题。汇率会怎样？

segments.en: Okay, these are two questions. First of all, what happened to the export windfall? If you look at the, well, I want to slide correction on the trade surplus number, right?
segments.zh: 好，这是两个问题。首先，出口收益去了哪里？如果你看，我想对贸易顺差数字稍作修正，对吧？

segments.en: 1.1 trillion. 1.2 is like cost of data. 1.1 is the BOP data. But we all want to talk about motion that's a good trade.
segments.zh: 1.1万亿。1.2万亿是海关数据。1.1万亿是国际收支数据。但我们想讨论的是贸易流动。

segments.en: If you can't services, that's much smaller. So the current account is like 800 billion. Okay, I lost it. But that's a little down the side.
segments.zh: 如果算上服务贸易，那就小得多。所以经常账户大约是8000亿。好吧，我记不清了。但那是次要的。

segments.en: I think last year, what happened is, you know, previously, it's recycling through central bank, central bank investment on behalf, right?
segments.zh: 我认为去年发生的情况是，以前是通过央行，央行代为配置，对吧？

segments.en: Or the private sector, they make exports income to don't change back to the MNB. So we have a current account surplus, but we don't have flows from outside China.
segments.zh: 或者私营部门，他们赚取出口收入但不换回人民币。所以我们有经常账户顺差，但没有来自境外的资金流入。

segments.en: Since last year, it has fundamentally changed. They started switching back to the MNB. That's why, you know, remember that I was here early December, calling for, there's going to be a stronger MNB.
segments.zh: 从去年开始，情况发生了根本变化。他们开始换回人民币。这就是为什么，记得我12月初在这里预测人民币会走强。

segments.en: Since then, it has appreciated more than, I think, 6%. This year, 4% against your dollar.
segments.zh: 自那以来，我认为它升值了超过6%。今年对美元升值了4%。

segments.en: So now, I think it's really Chinese companies, corporate household. They make foreign income abroad. They bring back onshore to China. And then from onshore to China, they're going to invest abroad again.
segments.zh: 所以现在，我认为确实是中国企业、企业和家庭。他们在海外赚取外汇收入。他们汇回中国境内。然后从中国境内，他们再次配置到海外。

segments.en: They're going to, you know, eat through Hong Kong Connect to Hong Kong market or through the ongoing overseas movement by FDI. Okay. So that's number one. How the recycle, the recycle has fundamentally shifted.
segments.zh: 他们会通过香港互联互通机制进入香港市场，或者通过持续的对外直接投资。好，这是第一点。回流路径已经发生了根本性转变。
